title: I'm more than shocked
content: It's been already 2 years of me going to mall world every night and never thought it was a shared experience, no one I know has ever had this type of place in their dreams so finding out there's a lot of us is comforting and scary at the same time. I've seen some maps that some of you have created (amazed by your skills btw) and it is so similar to mine. I want to start a dream journal, so I can compare and find out some differences or similarities we may have. However, I do have a couple of questions? 1. Is the theater like a cinema or more like a acting stage with a big screen behind? 2. Has someone seen dinosaurs on the beach? 3. Is it always tsunamis or do you experience earthquakes or volcano eruptions? 4. Have you visited the caves?
